content:
Manchester United has successfully secured the signing of Uruguayan midfielder Manuel Ugarte from Paris Saint-Germain in a deal amounting to €50 million, plus an additional €10 million in performance-related bonuses. The transfer marks a significant addition to Erik ten Hag's squad, as Ugarte promises to bring his determination and ambition to the club. The young talent, just 23 years old, has committed to a five-year contract, with the possibility of extending it for another year.

Upon joining the team, Ugarte expressed his excitement about playing for a club of Manchester United's stature, noting its global reputation and ambitious goals. He emphasized his eagerness to contribute to the club's successes, hoping to elevate their standing in the world of football and bring home trophies. Ugarte looks forward to engaging with the passionate fanbase at Old Trafford, demonstrating his commitment to hard work and teamwork.

Dan Ashworth, the sporting director of Manchester United, remarked on the acquisition of Ugarte as one of the key targets for the summer transfer window, indicating the strategic focus on enhancing the team's capabilities going forward. With this new signing, United aims to bolster their midfield and initiate a stronger campaign in the upcoming season.
